marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind east 25 knots diminishing to east 15 early Sunday morning
and to light early Sunday evening. Scattered flurries. Visibility 1 mile or less in
flurries. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>
